# A Developer Diary

> A comprehensive resource for learning machine learning, deep learning, NLP, and game development through detailed tutorials and implementations.

A Developer Diary is a technical blog covering practical implementations of AI/ML algorithms, neural networks, and game development using Python, PyTorch, and PyGame. The site features in-depth tutorials ranging from foundational concepts to advanced architectures, with a focus on hands-on coding examples and mathematical explanations.

## Key Topics

- PyTorch
- Transformer Model
- Support Vector Machines
- Machine Translation
- Deep Learning
- Natural Language Processing
- Dynamic Programming
- Neural Networks
- PyGame
- Encoder-Decoder Architecture
- Recurrent Neural Networks
- Gradient Descent
- Computer Vision
- Algorithm Tutorials
- Data Science

## Deep Learning & NLP

- [Coding Transformer Model from Scratch Using PyTorch - Part 1 (Understanding and Implementing the Architecture)](https://adeveloperdiary.com/data-science/deep-learning/nlp/coding-transformer-model-from-scratch-using-pytorch-part-1): PyTorch Transformer architecture guide covering self-attention and positional encoding
- [Coding Transformer Model from Scratch Using PyTorch - Part 2 (Data Processing and Preparation)](https://adeveloperdiary.com/data-science/deep-learning/nlp/coding-transformer-model-from-scratch-using-pytorch-part-2): PyTorch Transformer tutorial on data preprocessing, tokenization, and HuggingFace
- [Machine Translation using Recurrent Neural Network and PyTorch](https://adeveloperdiary.com/data-science/deep-learning/nlp/machine-translation-recurrent-neural-network-pytorch): Seq2Seq machine translation guide with encoder-decoder and RNN/LSTM in PyTorch
- [Machine Translation using Attention with PyTorch](https://adeveloperdiary.com/data-science/deep-learning/nlp/machine-translation-using-attention-with-pytorch): PyTorch machine translation tutorial using attention mechanisms and RNN/LSTM

## Machine Learning & Algorithms

- [Support Vector Machines for Beginners – Linear SVM (Part 1)](https://adeveloperdiary.com/data-science/machine-learning/support-vector-machines-for-beginners-linear-svm): Linear SVM tutorial with mathematical derivations and Python implementation
- [Support Vector Machines for Beginners – Duality Problem (Part 2)](https://adeveloperdiary.com/data-science/machine-learning/support-vector-machines-for-beginners-duality-problem): SVM duality problem guide covering quadratic programming and optimization
- [Support Vector Machines for Beginners – Kernel SVM (Part 3)](https://adeveloperdiary.com/data-science/machine-learning/support-vector-machines-for-beginners-kernel-svm): Kernel SVM tutorial explaining kernel trick and non-linear classification
- [Support Vector Machines for Beginners – Training Algorithms (Part 4)](https://adeveloperdiary.com/data-science/machine-learning/support-vector-machines-for-beginners-training-algorithms): SVM training algorithms guide covering gradient descent and optimization methods
- [Dynamic Programming - Unique Paths](https://adeveloperdiary.com/algorithm/dp/unique-paths): Dynamic programming tutorial solving unique paths algorithm problem
- [Algorithm](https://adeveloperdiary.com/algorithm): Algorithm tutorial hub covering data structures, coding patterns, and problem-solving

## Game Development

- [Coding Board Game Using PyGame (The Lost Expedition)](https://adeveloperdiary.com/python/pygame/coding-board-game-using-pygame-the-lost-expedition): PyGame tutorial for building The Lost Expedition board game with game loops
